title: STOCK MARKET UPDATE FOR 9/28/26
speaker: HJ (HJTrades)

macro_themes.view: PCE Wednesday pre-market and MU earnings Wednesday after close are where the movement will be; market may chop sideways until then.
QQQ is holding just under all-time highs while SPY is testing recent lows: mixed signals.
Cybersecurity names (CRWD, PANW, NET, FTNT, DDOG) were the strongest group; chips mixed; some healthcare setting up.

calls.quote: We're probably going to be pushing back up to test those.

STX second target '11.55' interpreted as ~1155. PFE '2921' read as 29.21, HP '6565' as 65.65, CAT '83050' as 830.50. NET and FTNT mentioned only as part of the cybersecurity basket (skipped).
